tests/test_itsdangerous/test_timed_regression.py::test_timed_serializer_bad_signature_contract: TimedSerializer(secret_key).loads on a tampered token raises BadSignature (BadTimeSignature family), and loads_unsafe returns (False, None) for a malformed token.
patches.rationale: The issue: TimestampSigner.unsign leaks a datetime ValueError when an invalid signature contains a decoded timestamp outside datetime's supported year range. The fix wraps timestamp_to_datetime in the invalid-signature path so that a malformed/out-of-range timestamp yields date_signed=None while still raising BadTimeSignature with the original payload. Valid roundtrips, ordinary invalid-signature date_signed metadata, expiry behavior, and the TimedSerializer BadSignature-family contract are preserved. New regression tests are added in a new file tests/test_itsdangerous/test_timed_regression.py.
